Market today:
Negative sentiment is hitting tech and chips hard. Elon Musk's "guppy-level death" comments are rattling cloud stocks, and Morgan Stanley sees up to 15% more downside for semiconductors. This directly impacts your concentrated book.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down 62.82% with a stop far above current price, and MUU is down 35.44%. Both are leveraged semiconductor ETFs facing direct negative news. SMCI is also down 24.93%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on overall tech sector sentiment and specifically how semiconductor names react to the Morgan Stanley warning.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged tech/chip positions.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is way above the current price of 83.56. Given the -62.82% loss and negative semiconductor news, review and set a protective stop or trim this highly leveraged position immediately.
MUU: Down 35.44% and leveraged. Its stop at 31.6 is also above current price (24.01). Consider trimming or setting a protective stop to manage risk.
SQQQ: With negative tech sentiment, consider a small hedge. Scanner shows SQQQ WATCH 7/12; entry 39.29-39.25, stop 39.19.
